Modern Cassius Lever in Matte Black

text.description_html:
Canaropa V2X17QS-C19, Modern Black Levers

The Cassius Matte Black Leverset is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions. The modern shape is accented by the contemporary matte black finish, which is becoming more popular in today's designing trends for is chic look and durability. The Modern Cassius Lever is adjustable to fit door thicknesses from 1-3/8 inches to 1-3/4 inches. The backset is also adjustable and is suitable either 2-3/8 inches or 2-3/4 inches.

Features and Specifications of the Cassius Modern Lever in Matte Black:

  • Finish: Matte Black
  • Lever Length: 5"
  • Overall Projection: 2-9/16"
  • Rose Projection: 1/2"
  • Rose Width: 2-1/2" square
  • Door Thickness: adjustable from 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: adjustable for 2-3/4" or 2-3/8"
  • 1 Year Manufacture Warranty

Available Functions: for Cassius Matte Black Leverset

  • Single Dummy: For use as a pull or to match trim, one (1) side.
  • Passage (Hall or Closet): Latchbolt operated by lever from either side at all times. For doors that don't need locking.
  • Privacy (Bedroom or Bathroom): Latchbolt operated by lever from either side or emergency release in outside lever. Outside locked by push button on inside rosette.

Sold Individually
